title: MORE MORE JUMP! Chapter1 Episode12 Thank You For Everything

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I need to go after Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll go with you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, are you sure you want to do that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You'll probably see things you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When they're not on stage, even idols are just regular people.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They get jealous of those with more talent.
They resent others for being more popular just because they think they're prettier.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If you go after Momoi now, you're sure to see things you wish you hadn't.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for worrying about me, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even so, I care too much for Momoi! I've got to go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Of course you would say that.
All right, Minori, I'll go as well.
Cheerful*Days Theater

rows.Speaker: Member A
rows.Line: Looks like Shizuku is all over the news.

rows.Speaker: Member B
rows.Line:
Yeah, what a pain.
Right when we were finally making progress with the new song recording, too.

rows.Speaker: Member C
rows.Line: Seriously. If she was going to quit, she could have at least made it look like she was moving on from the group instead of calling it quitting. This makes us look bad.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, you!

rows.Speaker: Member A
rows.Line: Huh? Airi?! What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm here to talk to you about Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Member B
rows.Line: Oh, that? What about it?

rows.Speaker: Member C
rows.Line: You always were tight with Shizuku. I don't see what this could possibly have to do with someone who ran away after arguing with their own agency, though.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*... Airi!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. I did run away.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I couldn't stand not getting work as an idol, so I left. Even then, I couldn't get anyone to see me as a proper idol, so I kept running.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even though what I should have done was work even harder to become the kind of idol I wanted to be.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But Shizuku is different!
She's been working hard as the center all this time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's been doing her best with all of you to give hope to your fans! That's why...

rows.Speaker: Member B
rows.Line: Why what?

rows.Speaker: Member B
rows.Line:
Shizuku is the one who decided to quit.
What does that have to do with us?

rows.Speaker: Member C
rows.Line: It's not like we told her to.

rows.Speaker: Member C
rows.Line: Besides, even if she stops working as an idol, a modeling agency or something would pick her up in no time.

rows.Speaker: Member A
rows.Line:
It must be so nice being pretty.
No matter how hard we worked, she always got picked over us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I hate the fact that I know exactly how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right! I was just as jealous as you are! Jealous of Shizuku's looks and the fact that she was so special!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I admit I was upset that she was always chosen over me no matter how much effort I put in!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But... Open your eyes!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku never once took advantage of her position! She always put in the effort to live up to everyone's expectations of her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
She continued trying to give hope to her fans.
That's why she's so popular. That's why she was chosen as lead!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All we did was start sulking in our own jealousy. She's nothing like us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm so horrible.
All I ever did was hurt you by only thinking of myself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even though you always believed in what I said and kept working hard to give everyone hope.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Sniff*...

rows.Speaker: Member A
rows.Line: What are you doing here anyway, Shizuku? You've got some nerve showing up here after messing up our schedules.

rows.Speaker: Member B
rows.Line: So, what? You go crying to Airi and have her show up to complain in your place? You're such a pain in the ass.

rows.Speaker: Member C
rows.Line: You said it. I'm glad to finally be rid of her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Why, you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Gasp*!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Momoi! Don't!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You can't, Momoi! You're an idol, remember?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And idols are supposed to give everyone hope!

rows.Speaker: Member B
rows.Line: Huh? Airi quit being an idol ages ago.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I almost lost it there. You're right. An idol shouldn't do something like that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank... Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for stopping her, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, uh, I-I didn't really do anything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And thank you too, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, I'm sorry. I...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's okay. What you said just now made me really happy. Probably the happiest I've been since becoming an idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You really are my idol, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Member A
rows.Line:
Hey, why exactly are you still here?
We've got practice, so could you leave already?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You don't have to worry.
I won't be returning to Cheerful*Days again.

rows.Speaker: Member A
rows.Line: Good. C'mon guys, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Goodbye, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sorry for being such a disappointing center. Thank you for everything.
